title: THE ULTIMATE BLACKMAIL 📄
topic: Betrayal by family and school secrets

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Mom, I saw the files [beat] and I know you've been selling out every kid in this school to Principal Huda for months!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Lower your voice Nix [beat] or you'll find out exactly how fast your college dreams can turn into a total nightmare.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You're supposed to protect me, not act like a double agent for that power-hungry principal [beat] you're a traitor to this family!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: I'm doing this for your future [beat] because your grades are a joke and your 'extracurriculars' are mostly criminal activities.

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: What is going on in here? Nix, why are you screaming at your mother [beat] like she's some kind of common criminal?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Because she is, Dad! She's the one who leaked the basement footage [beat] and she’s framing the other students for her own gain!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Rafiq, go back to the office. This is a private matter [beat] regarding Nix's recent 'unauthorized' entry into the school servers.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You're blackmailing your own son [beat] just to stay in Huda's good graces? That's pathetic and honestly it's just disgusting.

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: It's not blackmail, it's management. Now give me the USB drive you stole [beat] before I call the police myself right now.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I don't have it! I gave the drive to Joy [beat] and he's already uploading the proof of your secret deals online for everyone!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: You little idiot [beat] you have no idea who you're actually messing with or what Principal Huda is truly capable of doing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The air turned cold as Lubna pulled out a second phone [beat] and dialed a number Nix never expected to see her call.

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Hello, Principal Huda? The boy is being difficult [beat] it's time to initiate Phase Two of the disciplinary protocol immediately.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait, what is Phase Two? Mom [beat] what did you just do to my life and why are there sirens outside?
